stages.EMIT: main-file function definition for which emitrust-bx --emit=kernel reports no residual (none of its own, none inherited from an enclosing rejected class/namespace/template). Says NOTHING about rustc acceptance or behaviour.
stages.VERIFY: EMIT + byte-identical output against the clang-built original under a per-function differential harness. NOT IMPLEMENTED: column is empty by design and must never be filled with EMIT numbers.

meta.caveat:
CAVEAT: every blocker set below is a LOWER BOUND and every yield an UPPER BOUND.
emitrust-bx does not re-report cascades (uses of a rejected decl) and does not
descend into rejected constructs (a rejected class/namespace/template hides every
member; a non-canonical `for`/try hides its body; an expression residual such as
`?:` or an overloaded-operator call does not inspect its operands; uses of a
rejected local are silent). Supporting a tag WILL expose more tags.
The corpus here is two real Google codecs (woff2, brunsli), library + CLI TUs only.
meta.function_definition: main-file function definition with a body (FunctionDecl, CXXMethodDecl, ctor/dtor/conversion), deduped by source range within its TU; implicit and header-defined functions are not counted
meta.hidden_definition: bx rejected an enclosing class/namespace/template whole, or the function is a top-level out-of-line method/ctor/dtor bx rejects as one item: bx never inspected the body, its blocker set is a pure lower bound
